reuse.why: Reuses RSchedule, recurConfigToRSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, but not a shared per-occurrence weekend rule: the daily-skip vs move dispatch is re-written instead of extracted from getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: The skipWeekend/daily/move dispatch and the RSchedule construction plus try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper duplicate getUpcomingDates almost line for line.

placement.why: Handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in schedules/app.ts and is registered like the other handlers; the weekend rule arguably belongs in shared/schedules.ts alongside getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Readable and small, but a change to the weekend rule must now be made in getUpcomingDates, getNextDate and this new copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper; no extracted weekend-dispatch abstraction existed to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange: the getUpcomingDates if/else-if weekend dispatch reshaped into nested if with continue.
